name: Bamboo-tube rice
summary: Sticky rice cooked in a bamboo tube. Bảo tàng tỉnh Sơn La uses new sticky rice, closes the tube with banana leaf or fresh lá rong, and heats it on a wood fire. Báo Sơn La, on 4 September 2020, soaks nếp nương overnight, adds just enough water, stops the tube with banana leaf, and burns it until the shell chars and the water is gone, then splits it to the thin silk layer. Both stay.
origin: The Thái table. Bảo tàng tỉnh Sơn La, 21 March 2020. Báo Sơn La, 4 September 2020.
howToEat: From the tube, with the grilled fish or on its own. A salt dip was not in those two accounts. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Bản Mòng and the town table. The Mộc Châu tube stays on that plateau. A price is Check on arrival.
